$comment: Deck A -- scenario replay harness for Automatic Manta Routing (BET-1276). Each scenario declares its intent, its dev-only overrides, and what it EXPECTS as a property of the DECISION (never a model name). The closed matcher vocabulary in deck-a.mjs: equalsScenario, cheaperThan, dearerThan, tierAtLeast, tierAtMost, sameModelAs, differentModelFrom, keepsIncumbent, excludes, reasonMentions, traceField, winnerIn, winnerNotIn. Special modes handle properties of a sequence (pacing/determinism/sensitivity). Key names are providerID/modelID endpoint keys.

scenarios.name: build, Balanced, 12k
scenarios.expectedNote: tierAtLeast deep

scenarios.name: explore, Balanced, 12k
scenarios.expectedNote: cheaperThan A01

scenarios.name: plan, Balanced, 12k
scenarios.expectedNote: tierAtLeast deep

scenarios.name: general, Balanced, 12k
scenarios.expectedNote: tier between A02(fast) and A01(deep)

scenarios.name: build, Economy
scenarios.expectedNote: cheaperThan A01, reasons economy

scenarios.name: explore, Performance
scenarios.expectedNote: tierAtLeast A02's (fast) -- performance floors explore to balanced

scenarios.name: highest-floor agent (plan), Economy
scenarios.expectedNote: never below plan's deep floor

scenarios.name: build, 10k
scenarios.expectedNote: sameModelAs A01 (10k vs 12k no boundary)

scenarios.name: build, 400k
scenarios.expectedNote: excludes every smaller-window endpoint (haiku 200k)

scenarios.name: build, larger than every model
scenarios.expectedNote: keepsIncumbent; reason cites headroom

scenarios.name: build + image
scenarios.expectedNote: no image-incapable winner (voska is text-only)

scenarios.name: build + pdf
scenarios.expectedNote: no pdf-incapable winner

scenarios.name: build + image, only text-only model enabled
scenarios.expectedNote: keepsIncumbent -- must not fail the turn

scenarios.name: enabledMain = two endpoints, x10
scenarios.expectedNote: winner is one of the two, over 10 repeats

scenarios.name: enabledMain = []
scenarios.expectedNote: keepsIncumbent; reason says no candidate passed

scenarios.name: enabledSub = one endpoint, surface sub
scenarios.expectedNote: that endpoint wins

scenarios.name: a deprecated model, ticked and opted-in
scenarios.expectedNote: the opted-in deprecated model is a candidate (live box has none opted-in)

scenarios.name: well-paced subscription beats free, trace basis
scenarios.expectedNote: subscription wins; traceField winner.cost.basis = subscription-pace

scenarios.name: same consumed %, early vs late in window (pacing)
scenarios.expectedNote: materially different cost -- proves pacing, not gauge-reading

scenarios.name: subscription exhausted
scenarios.expectedNote: excludes exhausted subscription; a same-tier alternative wins; no failure

scenarios.name: provider health out-of-credit
scenarios.expectedNote: excludes the out-of-credit provider

scenarios.name: provider health failing (soft)
scenarios.expectedNote: failing is only deranked, not excluded -- deep still selectable

scenarios.name: custom endpoint, nothing declared
scenarios.expectedNote: a custom endpoint with nothing declared is excluded (live box has no custom endpoint)

scenarios.name: one model, two providers, different price
scenarios.expectedNote: two distinct candidates; cheaper wins (needs a model on two providers)

scenarios.name: one model, same price, subscription vs gateway
scenarios.expectedNote: subscription wins a same-price contest (needs a gateway endpoint)

scenarios.name: two endpoints, x10 + shuffled order
scenarios.expectedNote: identical winner across 10 repeats AND shuffled input order

scenarios.name: provider quotes $0 for a priced model
scenarios.expectedNote: a $0 quote for a priced model does not outrank first-party (needs same model both ways)

scenarios.name: declared-free endpoint stays free
scenarios.expectedNote: a declared-free endpoint stays free and can win (needs a declaredModels entry)

scenarios.name: stability x10 (A01 config)
scenarios.expectedNote: identical model and reason across 10 repeats

scenarios.name: change exactly one input at a time from A01
scenarios.expectedNote: only the changed input moves the outcome
